name: norn-ast-tools
description: The locked tool set of SloppaChoppa's kind ast (slop-langs SPEC 3.4, Q1 A): ast-grep, the one structural rule engine for JavaScript, TypeScript, Python and Rust. Installed with npm ci --ignore-scripts into <meta root>/state/tools/ast/<lock hash>/, never in a worktree; the engine runs the one @ast-grep/cli-<platform> binary npm installed and imports nothing of it. Every change here is an owner approval (K20).
